title: The welfare state: the CCSS, EBAIS and education
goal: Describe Costa Rica's health and education system and comment on a known fact, with el hecho de que + subjunctive.
grammar: commenting on a fact: el hecho de que + subjunctive (review)

sections.title: The welfare state: the CCSS, EBAIS and education
body: In this lesson you read about the Costa Rican social security system, its neighbourhood health teams and its schools. The text is in Spanish; the screens and instructions are in English.
The grammar is the one you know for commenting on a fact everyone knows: *el hecho de que* + subjunctive.

items: I can comment on a known fact with *el hecho de que* + subjunctive.
I can say what the CCSS and the EBAIS are.
I can name two challenges of the health system today.
